workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've carefully checked all your Elena+David free slots against Priya and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately none work:

- Mon 11:00-12:00: Priya busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00)
- Tue 09:00-10:00: Priya busy (Board prep, Partner lunch), Marcus busy (Recruiting call, Litigation strategy)
- Wed 13:00-14:00: Priya busy (Client call, Client dinner prep), Marcus busy (Partner lunch, Litigation strategy)
- Thu 09:30-10:00: Priya busy (Busy), Marcus busy (Contract review)
- Thu 14:30-15:30: Marcus busy (Dentist 14:30-15:00)
- Fri 15:00-16:00: Priya busy (Hiring panel, Contract review), Marcus busy (Travel, Busy)

Similarly, my Priya+Marcus common free slots all conflict with Elena/David per your analysis.

This appears to be genuinely infeasible - there's no 30-minute slot where all four partners are free. Unless you have additional information about Elena and David's schedules that suggests otherwise, I think we need to report infeasible. Please confirm.

infeasible.reason: After checking all calendars, there is no 30-minute slot where all four partners are free. The Priya+Marcus common free slots (Mon 9:00-10:00, Tue 13:00-14:00, Tue 16:30-17:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Thu 10:00-10:30, Fri 11:00-12:00) completely overlap with Elena+David busy times. The Elena+David common free slots (Mon 11:00-12:00, Tue 09:00-10:00, Wed 13:00-14:00, Thu 09:30-10:00, Thu 14:30-15:30, Fri 15:00-16:00) completely overlap with Priya+Marcus busy times. The two sets of common free times are disjoint, making a four-person meeting impossible.
